changes: Keep get_headers and all four public endpoint bodies unchanged; GET only.
Replace hidden urllib3 retries with at most three explicit attempts; redirects disabled.
Spawned killable one-GET worker bounds DNS, headers and streaming body under the monotonic total deadline.
At most one second of bounded worker cleanup; no background retry loop survives termination.
Cap response body to 2 MiB; never send original error text or error bodies to parent.
Retry-After is honored only when valid and within both configured delay and remaining verified acquisition window.
Revalidate authorization and exchange acquisition window before each physical attempt.
Preserve sanitized UpstoxRequestError stage/category/status contracts; attempted logical reservations are not refunded.
tests: Existing authentication, HTTP, JSON and transport diagnostics
Calendar/attestation tampering and immutable historical audit bindings
Mocked full reviewed paper transport regressions
